title: 第13章 谁要做师妹她要当师姐第14章 形意六合第三格鲁班锁开启
slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
天，彻底大亮。
可铅云依旧在高空中汇聚，鹅毛大雪飘零洒落，换来千里冰封，万里雪飘。
这样的寒冬大雪，堪称一场雪灾，对于云霄城外的流民而言，乃真正的大灾难。
大多数人兴许都难以捱过寒冬，迎来春风。
李浪绘制完设计图后，虽然一夜未眠，但似乎因神工之心的刺激，依旧精神，便起身准备早餐。
桌上，兄妹二人吃着温热的烧饼，配上稀粥。
“清清，今日你跟哥一起去雕工铺。”
李浪三两口将烧饼塞入口中，对着正在哧溜喝粥的清清喊道。
“啊？！”
清清满嘴粥糊，茫然的抬起头。
随后，小脑袋好似终于处理完信息，黑枣般的眼睛陡然亮起来！
“真的咩？！”
“哥你要带我去铺子里玩呐？！”
清清开心的不得了，小脸蛋上的肉肉乱颤起来。
“嗯，要乖乖的，不要乱跑，跟在哥身边。”
李浪说道。
昨日那戴着野猪面具的男人，给李浪带来太大压力。
他不放心将清清一个人留在屋子里了。
至少，在搬入到唐氏府邸内之前，不能让清清一个人。
小丫头可太开心了，一个早上都在扭着屁股，哼着歌谣，这脾性倒是跟李浪一般像，李浪开心时候也是这副德行。

收拾完毕后，李浪戴上斗笠，也给清清盖上斗笠，裹上厚棉服，锁好门后，离开了院子。
顶着风雪，一路来到了唐氏雕工铺。
铺子内炉火烧着，热气腾腾，驱散了严寒。
“李雕师来了啊！”
“李雕师早上好。”
“嘿，小丫头长得真精致，真好看！”
……
李浪带着清清到铺子里，便有不少雕工学徒给李浪主动打招呼，眸中满是尊敬。
今日的铺子清冷了不少，一场雕师考核，会清理掉一批到年龄的老学徒。
至少，在新的学徒未曾招来前，铺子都会比往常冷清些。
李浪面带温和之色，牵着清清，倒也没有太过倨傲，一路跟学徒们打招呼，随后来到了内院，属于自己的工房。
而刚到自己的工房，一身鲜艳如火红裙的倪嫣便跑来串门，她的工房就在李浪的隔壁不远。
“浪师弟，这是你妹妹啊？真可爱！”
倪嫣依旧戴着面纱，露出水灵灵的黑眼睛。
“姐姐好呐！”
清清乖巧的问好。
奶声奶气的声音，快要把倪嫣的心给化了。
“我是师兄。”
李浪眉头一皱，认真的纠正道。
叶大师说了，他与倪嫣暂时是师兄妹的关系！

这丫头，怎么转眼就要压在他头上。
content_en:
The sky is completely bright.
But lead clouds are still gathering in the sky, and heavy snowflakes are falling, resulting in thousands of miles of ice and thousands of miles of snow drifting.
Such heavy snowfall in cold winter can be called a snow disaster, and for the refugees outside Yunxiao City, it is a real disaster.
It may be difficult for most people to survive the cold winter and welcome the spring breeze.
After Li Lang finished drawing the design, although he stayed up all night, he seemed to be still energetic due to the stimulation of his magical heart, so he got up to prepare breakfast.
At the table, the brother and sister ate warm sesame seed cakes with gruel.
"Qingqing, you and your brother will go to the carving shop together today."
Li Lang stuffed the sesame biscuits into his mouth in a few mouthfuls and shouted to Qingqing who was sipping porridge.
"Ah?!"
Qingqing raised her head blankly with her mouth full of porridge.
Then, the little head seemed to have finally processed the information, and the black jujube-like eyes suddenly lit up!
"Really?!"
"Brother, you want to take me to the shop to play?!"
Qingqing was so happy that the flesh on her little face trembled wildly.
"Well, be good, don't run around, and stay with me."
Li Lang said.
The man wearing a wild boar mask yesterday put too much pressure on Li Lang.
He was worried about leaving Qingqing alone in the house.
At least, Qingqing cannot be left alone before moving into the Tang family's mansion.
The little girl was so happy that she spent the whole morning wiggling her buttocks and humming songs. Her temperament was similar to that of Li Lang. Li Lang also behaved like this when he was happy.
After finishing cleaning up, Li Lang put on a bamboo hat, covered Qingqing with a bamboo hat, wrapped herself in thick cotton clothes, locked the door, and left the yard.
Braving the wind and snow, we arrived at Tang's Carving Shop.
The fire was burning in the shop, and the heat was rising, dispelling the severe cold.
"Carver Li is here!"
"Good morning, Carver Li."
"Hey, the little girl is so delicate and beautiful!"
…
When Li Lang took Qingqing to the shop, many carving apprentices took the initiative to greet Li Lang, their eyes full of respect.
The shop is a lot cooler today. A carver assessment will eliminate a group of old apprentices.
At least, until new apprentices are recruited, the shop will be deserted than usual.
With a gentle look on his face, Li Lang held Qingqing's hand, but he was not too arrogant. He greeted the apprentices all the way, and then came to his own workshop in the inner courtyard.
As soon as she arrived at her workshop, Ni Yan, dressed in a bright red dress, came to visit her. Her workshop was not far from Li Lang's.
"Junior Brother Lang, is this your sister? She's so cute!"
Ni Yan still wore a veil, revealing her watery black eyes.
"Hello sister!"
Qingqing said hello sweetly.
The sound of milky milk almost melted Ni Yan's heart.
"I am senior brother."
Li Lang frowned and corrected him seriously.
Master Ye said that he and Ni Yan are brothers and sisters for the time being!
How could this girl be on top of him in the blink of an eye?
